The recommended daily intake of nuts for men is about 1.5 ounces or 42 grams. 

Assuming that an average serving size of roasted, salted nuts is around 1 ounce or 28 grams, an average male can consume about 1-2 servings of nuts per day. 

Therefore, an average male may eat around 1-2 servings of roasted, salted nuts per day.
